# Spottly
> Spottly is a mobile house-cleaning company serving Los Angeles — from the Westside to Koreatown — offering standard, deep, move-in/move-out, recurring, Airbnb turnover, and commercial cleaning, built on a founder's obsession with the small details.

## Contact
- Phone: (213) 277-8247
- Email: info@spottly.co
- Hours: By appointment — contact for availability
- Website: https://www.spottly.co

## Services
- Standard Cleaning (/services/standard-cleaning): Routine upkeep that keeps a home consistently fresh.
- Deep Cleaning (/services/deep-cleaning): Top-to-bottom reset for a lived-in home, including inside appliances and behind furniture.
- Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning (/services/move-in-move-out-cleaning): Empty-home clean built to protect a security deposit or ready a new place.
- Recurring Cleaning (/services/recurring-cleaning): Weekly, biweekly, or monthly service at a lower per-visit rate.
- Airbnb Cleaning (/services/airbnb-cleaning): Short-term rental turnovers with linens, restock, and photo proof.
- Commercial Cleaning (/services/commercial-cleaning): Office and janitorial cleaning, after-hours or day-porter.

## Service Areas
- Santa Monica (/service-areas/santa-monica): Beach-air and rent-controlled apartment cleaning.
- Culver City (/service-areas/culver-city): Studio/tech offices and downtown apartments.
- Beverly Hills (/service-areas/beverly-hills): Luxury estate recurring and deep cleaning.
- West Hollywood (/service-areas/west-hollywood): Dense renter-city apartment and turnover cleaning.
- Marina del Rey (/service-areas/marina-del-rey): Waterfront condo and short-term rental turnovers.
- Venice (/service-areas/venice): Airbnb turnovers and Silicon Beach offices.
- Sawtelle (/service-areas/sawtelle): Japantown and UCLA-adjacent apartment cleaning.
- Brentwood (/service-areas/brentwood): Estate and fire-zone hillside deep cleaning.
- Westchester (/service-areas/westchester): LAX-area family homes and LMU rentals.
- Mid-City (/service-areas/mid-city): Mid-City West / Miracle Mile / Park La Brea apartments.
- Koreatown (/service-areas/koreatown): Dense pre-war apartment and commercial cleaning.
